parts.gloss: she who is suited to the wealth

words.gloss: she who is suited to the wealth

literal: Worthy of the home, excellence she who possesses having become, her own he who took's wealth she who is suited to, is life's companion.
translation: A true life companion is one who possesses the excellence worthy of family life and adapts herself to her husband's means.
modern: குடும்ப வாழ்விற்கு ஏற்ற நற்பண்புகளை உடையவளாகி, தன்னை மனைவியாக ஏற்ற கணவனின் வருவாய்க்கு ஏற்ப வாழ்பவளே சிறந்த வாழ்க்கைத்துணை ஆவாள்.
explanation: This couplet defines the ideal qualities of a life companion. The phrase 'மனைத்தக்க மாண்பு' refers to the moral excellence and virtues required to maintain a harmonious household. Furthermore, 'வளத்தக்காள்' emphasizes the practical wisdom of managing the home according to the husband's financial resources. Together, these traits of virtuous character and financial prudence make a spouse a true partner in life.
